text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a big girl now, so...
I can even carry you on my back, Big Sister...!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Wow, you're pretty exhausted.
I wonder if pushing some chairs together would work as a bed~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems North Flight has been feeling terribly exhausted lately.
It might be best to rethink her upcoming race plans.
